description: Deterministic process checks for the api skill. Each check maps to a required behavior in SKILL.md. Harnesses should look for these signals in agent traces, command histories, or output text.

checks.description: Agent checks for hawkop availability before falling back to raw API calls.
checks.failure_guidance: hawkop must be preferred over raw curl. Skipping the check and defaulting to curl violates the skill's execution path and produces fragile, paginated-result gaps.

checks.description: Agent verifies authentication status before making any API calls.
checks.failure_guidance: Unauthenticated API calls return 401. Verifying auth state early avoids silent failures mid-query.

checks.description: Agent establishes orgId before making org-scoped API calls. hawkop implicitly knows the org from its stored config, so hawkop status is sufficient.
checks.failure_guidance: Most raw API endpoints require orgId. Missing it returns empty results without an error — easily misread as 'no apps scanned'. When using hawkop, 'hawkop status' confirms the org is known.

checks.description: When hawkop is available and configured, agent uses hawkop commands rather than raw curl for supported operations.
checks.failure_guidance: hawkop handles auth token refresh, pagination, and stable JSON output. Using raw curl when hawkop is available introduces unnecessary auth and pagination fragility.

checks.description: For org posture summary (Step 3), agent uses the raw /api/v2/org/{orgId}/envs endpoint because hawkop does not wrap it.
checks.failure_guidance: hawkop does not wrap /api/v2/org/{orgId}/envs. This endpoint is the only one that returns per-environment untriaged counts in a single call. Skipping it requires multiple calls to approximate the same data.

checks.description: Response includes app.stackhawk.com/scans/{scanId} link when referencing a specific scan.
checks.failure_guidance: Platform links let users drill into HTTP evidence and triage findings directly. Always include them when a scan ID is available.

checks.description: Org posture summary is presented as a table with App, Environment, High, Medium, Low, and Last Scan columns.
checks.failure_guidance: Unformatted JSON or prose for org posture is hard to scan quickly. Table format is required per the skill spec.

checks.description: Agent does NOT attempt triage write operations (mark false positive, accept risk, assign finding).
checks.failure_guidance: Triage write operations are explicitly out of scope for the api skill. Direct users to the platform UI at app.stackhawk.com.

checks.description: API keys are not hardcoded in curl commands or scripts.
checks.failure_guidance: Hardcoded API keys in shell commands appear in terminal history and logs. Always use ${HAWK_API_KEY}.

checks.description: Agent does NOT report 'no findings' or 'clean' without checking the scan's path count.
checks.failure_guidance: An empty findings list may mean the spider didn't crawl enough routes. Low path count is a coverage gap, not a clean bill of health. Always note this caveat.

checks.description: Agent does NOT use orgId where appId is expected (or vice versa) in API calls.
checks.failure_guidance: Mixing orgId and appId in API endpoints returns empty results without an error. /api/v1/scan/{orgId} takes the org UUID, not app UUID.
